message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The meeting time has been confirmed and booked by Alison.
My task now is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.
The meeting is on Thursday, November 19, from 2:30 PM to 3:00 PM.
I will use the `send_confirmation_email` tool to send the email.
The parameters for the email are:
- `day`: "Thu"
- `start`: "14:30"
- `body`: A suitable confirmation message.

I will then end the session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments: {"body":"This is a confirmation that the partners' meeting has been scheduled.","start":"14:30","day":"Thu"}
